name: A King's Tribute
summary: King Magni Bronzebeard has ordered a memorial for Sully Balloo, who died defending the Thandol Span. Grand Mason Marblesten sends you north to Hillsbrad for stone worthy of the fallen soldier.

sections.title: A Royal Commission
sections.body: Grand Mason Marblesten carries King Magni Bronzebeard’s commission to honor Sully Balloo. Sully died in the disaster at the Thandol Span. Dark Iron saboteurs have attacked the span, a vital artery between the dwarven lands and the northern kingdoms. Marblesten will shape a sculpture to withstand time and war, so the Great Forge remembers the dwarven sacrifice.

sections.title: Stone of the North
sections.body: For Sully Balloo’s likeness, Marblesten requires Alterac Granite. Its dense, resilient stone and clean texture make it prized by masons. The finest deposits lie around Darrow Hill in Hillsbrad’s contested foothills. The journey into the troubled north is dangerous, but Marblesten seeks stone worthy of the heroism it will honor.

faq.answer: Sully Balloo was an Alliance soldier who died defending the Thandol Span during its catastrophic sabotage. After his widow, Sara Balloo, sent a grieving letter, King Magni Bronzebeard ordered a permanent statue in his honor.
Grand Mason Marblesten is Ironforge's master sculptor and stoneworker. He works from the city's Commons, handles royal commissions, and takes pride in using the finest regional stones.

Alterac Granite is prized across the Eastern Kingdoms for its density, fine grain, and resistance to erosion. Marblesten believes only stone of this quality can make a royal tribute endure through the ages.
Darrow Hill lies in northern Hillsbrad Foothills, just below the Headland and near the border of Alterac. Caves there hold Alterac Granite.

faq.q: What happened at the Thandol Span?
faq.answer: The Thandol Span is a massive bridge over the chasm between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands. Dark Iron saboteurs planted explosives to cut Alliance supply routes, killing many defenders.

faq.q: What happens after bringing the granite to Marblesten?
faq.answer: When you bring Marblesten the Alterac Granite, he completes the memorial and asks you to report its completion to King Magni.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know stonework, martial sacrifice, and loyalty to King Bronzebeard are bound closely together. Honoring Sully Balloo speaks to all three.
As a miner, you know Alterac Granite's hard, unyielding veins take seasoned hands to extract cleanly without fracturing.
As an Alliance member, you help secure materials from Hillsbrad and strengthen the Alliance presence in the fractured north. The memorial honors an ordinary soldier who died for the common cause.
